format: HTML with embedded JavaScript and Smarty templating
description: This file appears to be a template for a web page involved in a campaign creation or editing wizard within SuiteCRM, featuring HTML, embedded JavaScript, and Smarty template syntax. It includes form elements, scripts for UI interaction, and template logic for a campaign wizard interface.

methods.name: determine_back
methods.description: Handles navigation backward through the wizard steps, setting form state and submitting for specific step transitions.

methods.name: refreshMarketingSelect
methods.description: Fetches and updates the marketing email selection options based on campaign data.

methods.name: saveMarketingAndTemplate
methods.description: Saves the selected marketing and template data via AJAX POST request, updating validation messages and UI indicators.

methods.name: onScheduleClick
methods.description: Triggers scheduling logic for sending campaign emails.

methods.name: onSendAsTestClick
methods.description: Handles the logic for sending the campaign email as a test.

methods.name: onNext
methods.description: Advances the wizard to the next step, with validation and state management.

methods.name: changeNextBtnLabel
methods.description: Updates the label of the 'Next' button depending on the current step.

methods.name: toDate
methods.description: Converts a date string into a JavaScript Date object according to user preferences.

methods.name: set_from_email_and_name
methods.description: Sets the 'from email' and 'from name' fields based on selected mailbox.

methods.name: set_from_reply_info
methods.description: Populates 'reply-to' name and address fields based on selected mailbox options.

methods.name: toggle_tracker_url
methods.description: Enables or disables tracker URL input based on the opt-out checkbox.

methods.name: setTrackerUrlSelectVisibility
methods.description: Displays or hides tracker URL input fields depending on selection.

methods.name: loadtemplate
methods.description: Loads the selected email template for editing or copying.

methods.name: edit_email_template_form
methods.description: Opens a popup window to edit the selected email template.

methods.name: open_email_template_form
methods.description: Opens a popup window for creating or editing email templates.

methods.name: refresh_email_template_list
methods.description: Updates the email template dropdown with a new or modified template.

methods.name: toggle_message_for
methods.description: Enables or disables message scope selection based on a checkbox.
